recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
chmod +x gradlew
echo "storeFilePath=/dev/null" > signing.properties
echo "storePassword=storePassword" >> signing.properties
echo "keyPassword=keyPassword" >> signing.properties
echo "keyAlias=keyAlias" >> signing.properties
./gradlew assembleRelease
git clone -b v0.2.8 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
OUT=app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --page-size 16 fix-newlines "$OUT" 'META-INF/services/*'
mv "$OUT" /outputs/unsigned.apk
